answer: Proof-of-work admission requires each answer to carry a one-use hash ticket bound to its epoch, account and text, including wander, relic and fable. A verifier checks the binding and target before accepting it. N submissions need N separately mined tickets; splitting fixed hash power across N accounts does not increase expected throughput. The target must make farming unprofitable relative to rewards. This meters computation, not unique people; cheaper hardware or stolen compute can weaken the cost.
